trace.gripper_target_difference: Raw gripper target versus motor-buffer target differs up to 0.035137m; native MetaControl.process_gripper_val limits each substep target to current opening +/-20% of configured range. This comparison is before that limiter and must not be presented as a motor-mapping failure.

affected_points: Checkpoint action decoding to native joint/gripper keys
confirmed_contract_gap.mechanism: The checkpoint left-gripper channel is currently treated as right arm joint1 and included in the joint-delta inverse. The checkpoint right wrist joint channel is currently treated as left gripper, bypasses absolute-joint reconstruction and is clipped as an opening command.

limits: No claim that an unlimited diagnostic is benchmark comparable.
